text: BAM share fell 0.01 percentage points over 25 hours and 0.06 percentage points over 7 days, leaving 32.8% of all Solana stake routed through BAM. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee holds 23.7% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The 61 top-node leadership changes are best read as whale-driven routing, not evidence of structural rollover.
